provenance: Assignment author review: examined complete new rules and concrete example propositions together with their setup definitions. Reviewed fixed binding metadata, partial-view store updates, RHS-first ordering, runtime writable/replaceable guards, frame GC and forward Destructor embedding. Explicitly retained the demonstrated older-ID invariant failure and missing Assignment soundness/reflection as future proof obligations. Existing claims and selected sources were compared byte-for-byte with prior reviewed packets; new AGENTS scope and SUMMARY insertion were inspected. This is differential author review for unchanged units, not an independent review. CLI workers only partition immutable evidence preparation/recording; no subagents were used.
rationale: The landing md/given.md#claim-given.unpacking directly introduces Given unpacking transition semantics. Links Eval, original Let, extended pattern syntax and the class table. The removal/map-extension equations are local adjuncts defining Unpack, not unexplained global operators. The public wrapper additionally links collection and initial-frame exit, distinguishing it from the local statement operation. Eval and Δ(C) in the rule are linked. Removal of the container and adding the enumerated field slots are given by local equations and freshness/order adjuncts. Public transitions collect after local evaluation or pop an exhausted frame; these rules define the wrapper in place. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter. Assignment insertion shifts subsequent chapter positions but leaves existing authored passages, targets, relative concept order and prior classifications unchanged. Required non-audit inputs were compared exactly, except the reviewed SUMMARY and AGENTS updates.
limitations: Author editorial self-review. Extraction and byte ranges do not establish clarity by themselves. Earlier unchanged passages retain the prior review after exact-input comparison. Future notes remain nonnormative.
